#10 “ChatGPT is safe for my confidential files.”
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: No, ChatGPT does not *read* the entire internet.

Also, you have to “call” its data with the right prompt (*hence why people love prompts*). For eg. if you say “Act like a data engineer”, ChatGPT will directly go to its “data engineer database”. The answer will be insta
